product_category: AI-powered workplace safety and workers' compensation platform
description: A fictional market of 100 employers in high-injury industries. Each company has five people with a stake in the buying decision: the broker of record, the CFO, the IT manager, the safety manager and a frontline worker. Each person carries 3-5 pain points drawn from their role, plus one that is specific to their role in their industry. Replace the industry mix with your real customer distribution, and rewrite roles and pain points to fit your own ICP.

themes.cost: Premiums, claim costs, total cost of risk
themes.relationship: Trust with clients, employers or crews

roles.label: Insurance broker
roles.context: Works for an outside brokerage. Places the policy, owns the client relationship and earns commission on it. Wary of anything that goes around them or makes them look out of date.

core_pains.label: Improve client relationships
core_pains.description: Wants to be the strategic advisor clients call all year, not just the person who shows up at renewal with quotes.

core_pains.label: Stand out in a commodity market
core_pains.description: Every broker quotes the same carriers at similar prices. Needs something competitors can't offer.

core_pains.label: Make more commission
core_pains.description: Wants to place more premium, win new accounts and grow the book without adding headcount.

optional_pains.label: Keep clients at renewal
optional_pains.description: A painful renewal is when a client shops the account to another broker.

optional_pains.label: Get leverage with carriers
optional_pains.description: Needs data to negotiate better terms and fight off non-renewals in a hard market.

optional_pains.label: Servicing small accounts profitably
optional_pains.description: Loss runs, certificates and claim follow-up eat the time that should go to selling.

roles.label: CFO
roles.context: Owns the insurance line item and total cost of risk. Wants hard-dollar ROI and a payback period, not soft safety benefits.

core_pains.label: Rising workers' comp premium
core_pains.description: The premium and experience mod keep climbing, and renewal is a painful conversation with leadership.

core_pains.label: Unpredictable total cost of risk
core_pains.description: Claims, reserves and premium audits make the insurance budget impossible to forecast.

optional_pains.label: Every new spend needs hard ROI
optional_pains.description: New software only gets approved with a clear payback period.

optional_pains.label: Claim costs hitting the P&L
optional_pains.description: Large claims and reserves move quarterly results.

optional_pains.label: Lost productivity from injuries
optional_pains.description: Injured workers mean overtime, temps and missed output.

optional_pains.label: Premium audit surprises
optional_pains.description: Payroll classification mistakes turn into surprise bills after the policy year.

roles.label: IT manager
roles.context: Small team covering many sites. Has to approve cameras on the network, where data is stored, integrations and the support load.

core_pains.label: Securing video and employee data
core_pains.description: Any vendor touching camera footage or HR data is a security and legal review.

core_pains.label: Small team, too many systems
core_pains.description: Every new tool means more tickets, more logins and more things to patch.

optional_pains.label: Integrating with HR, payroll and claims systems
optional_pains.description: Data lives in disconnected systems, and every integration breaks on the next update.

optional_pains.label: Vendor security reviews
optional_pains.description: SOC 2 reports, questionnaires and contracts for every new vendor.

optional_pains.label: Cameras and networks across sites
optional_pains.description: Every location has different hardware, bandwidth and someone who 'knows the password'.

roles.label: Safety manager
roles.context: Owns the safety program, incident investigations and training. Usually understaffed and covering more sites than they can walk.

core_pains.label: Preventing injuries before they happen
core_pains.description: Finds out about unsafe behavior and near-misses after someone is already hurt.

core_pains.label: Can't be on every site
core_pains.description: Too many sites and shifts for one person or a small team to observe.

optional_pains.label: OSHA logs, inspections and citations
optional_pains.description: Recordkeeping and inspection readiness take time away from the floor.

optional_pains.label: Slow incident investigations
optional_pains.description: Root cause takes weeks of interviews and paperwork.

optional_pains.label: Proving safety's value to leadership
optional_pains.description: Safety is seen as a cost center. Needs numbers to win budget.

optional_pains.label: Getting crews to take training seriously
optional_pains.description: Training is a checkbox and behavior doesn't change.

roles.label: Frontline worker
roles.context: Does the physical work. Cares about getting home uninjured and not being watched or blamed. Has seen safety programs come and go.

core_pains.label: Getting hurt on the job
core_pains.description: Knows people who've been injured, and knows what an injury does to a paycheck.

core_pains.label: Being watched and blamed
core_pains.description: Worries that cameras and data get used for discipline, not protection.

optional_pains.label: Pressure to work faster than is safe
optional_pains.description: Quotas and short staffing push people to cut corners.

optional_pains.label: Fear of reporting an injury
optional_pains.description: Worries that reporting a strain or near-miss marks them as a problem.

optional_pains.label: Safety programs that are just paperwork
optional_pains.description: Has signed a lot of forms. Nothing changed on the floor.

broker.label: Wrap-ups and subcontractor requirements

cfo.label: A high mod loses bids
cfo.description: General contractors and owners screen out bidders with a high EMR.

it_manager.label: Connectivity on temporary job sites
it_manager.description: Job sites move every few months and rarely have reliable networks.

safety_manager.label: Falls and subcontractor safety
safety_manager.description: Fall protection and keeping subs to the same standard across job sites.

worker.label: Falls and struck-by hazards

broker.label: Clients with repetitive-strain claims
broker.description: Ergonomic claims are slow, expensive and hard to explain to carriers.

cfo.label: Lost-time claims stall production
cfo.description: One injury on a line can cost a shift's output.

it_manager.label: Plant-floor network segmentation
it_manager.description: Cameras and sensors near OT systems need to be isolated.

safety_manager.label: Machine guarding and lockout/tagout
safety_manager.description: The most-cited OSHA violations in the plant.

worker.label: Repetitive strain from line work
worker.description: The same motion hundreds of times a shift.

broker.label: Peak-season claim spikes
broker.description: Clients' claims jump with temp labor every peak season.

cfo.label: Temp labor drives claims
cfo.description: New and temporary workers get hurt at higher rates.

it_manager.label: Cameras across large DCs
it_manager.description: Hundreds of cameras and a WMS that doesn't talk to anything.

safety_manager.label: Lifting injuries and forklift incidents
safety_manager.description: Manual handling and powered equipment drive most claims.

worker.label: Rate quotas and heavy lifting

cfo.label: Caregiver injuries deepen staffing gaps

worker.label: Lifting residents short-staffed

broker.label: Hard market for transportation accounts
broker.description: Carriers are pulling back and every account is a fight to place.

cfo.label: Combined auto and comp losses
cfo.description: Driver injuries hit workers' comp and auto at the same time.

it_manager.label: Telematics already in place
it_manager.description: Trucks already have cameras and telematics. Doesn't want a second system.

it_manager.label: Limited connectivity at remote sites

safety_manager.label: Training a seasonal, multilingual crew
safety_manager.description: New workers every season, in several languages.

worker.label: Heat, knives and cold rooms

broker.label: Many small locations, small premiums
broker.description: Lots of locations with thin premium per account. Hard to service profitably.

cfo.label: Turnover drives new-hire injuries

cfo.description: A premium increase eats a real share of store profit.

triggers: experience mod went above 1.2 at the last renewal
had a serious injury on site this year
lost the safety coordinator and has not backfilled
board asked for a total cost of risk review
nothing urgent, claims have been quiet
